title: Synthesis and coordination ability of the first phosphavinyl(selenoxo)phosphorane: an electronic story

The Mes*PC(Cl)–P(Se)(i-Pr)2 phosphavinyl(selenoxo)phosphorane is the first derivative of this new class of compounds embedding in the same unit a λ2 P(III) and a λ4 P(V) atom.
